visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.

na santi kāmā manujesu niccā, sant'īdha kamanīyāni yesu baddho, yesu pamatto apun'āgamanaṃ, anāgantā puriso maccudheyyā'ti.
diṭṭhā vā y'eva adiṭṭhā, ye ca dūre vasanti avidūre, bhūtā vā sambhav'esī vā, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.
yo ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammaṃ'y'eva sakkaronto, dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto, dhammaṃ mānento, dhammaṃ pūjento, dhammaṃ apacāyamāno suvaco hoti, sovacassataṃ āpajjati, tam'ahaṃ suvaco'ti vadāmi.

cattāro'me, bhikkhave, yogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.
ayoge yuñjam'attānaṃ, yogasmiñ'ca ayojayaṃ, atthaṃ hitvā piyaggāhī, pihet'att'ānuyoginaṃ.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhan'ti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yogo karaṇīyo'ti.
yogā ve jāyatī bhūri, ayogā bhūrisaṅkhayo, etaṃ dvedhāpathaṃ ñatvā, bhavāya vibhavāya ca, tath'āttānaṃ niveseyya, yathā bhūri pavaḍḍhati.
paññāya chetvā vipath'ānusārinaṃ, yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya, disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañ'ca sambhavaṃ, dāy'ādako hehisi aggavādino.

vamanan'ti yogaṃ datvā vamanakaraṇaṃ. virecane'pi es'eva nayo.

evaṃ vihārī ātāpī, ahorattam'atandito, bhāvayaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, yogakkhemassa pattiyā.

54218.meaning1: wishing for safety; wanting release from bondage; desiring Nibbāna
54218.meaning2: wishing for personal safety; wanting enlightenment
54218.commentary: (DNa) yogakkhemakāmo'ti yogato khemakāmo. (NIDD1a) yogakkhemakāmā'ti catūhi yogehi khemaṃ nibbhayaṃ kāmā.

examples.text: ye vā pan'assa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukakāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā, yā tehi saddhiṃ asaṅgati asamāgamo asamodhānaṃ amissībhāvo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho.

tass'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahato migasaṅghassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo. so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ vivareyya, pidaheyya kummaggaṃ, ūhaneyya okacaraṃ, nāseyya okacārikaṃ.

54220.meaning1: carrying to sanctuary; transporting to release from the yoke
54220.commentary: (SNa) yogakkhem'ādhivāhanan'ti ettha yogehi khemattā nibbānaṃ yogakkhemaṃ nāma, taṃ adhikicca vāhīyati, abhimukhaṃ vā vāhīyatī'ti adhivāhanaṃ, yogakkhemassa adhivāhanaṃ yogakkhem'ādhivāhanan'ti.

examples.text: vīriyaṃ me dhuradhorayhaṃ, yogakkhem'ādhivāhanaṃ, gacchati anivattantaṃ, yattha gantvā na socati.

54221.meaning1: discourse on one who is free from bondage; teaching about one who is safe

examples.text: tesañ'ca pahānāya akkhāsi yogaṃ, tasmā tathāgato yogakkhemī'ti vuccati. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yogakkhemipariyāyo dhammapariyāyo'ti.

54223.meaning2: Chapter 11 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

54224.commentary: (DNa) yogakkhemo'ti nibbānass'eva nāmaṃ, accanto yogakkhemo etesan'ti accantayogakkhemī. (ITIa) catūhi yogehi anupaddutattā yogakkhemaṃ, nibbānaṃ arahattañ'ca, tassa anadhigamena ayogakkhemino.

examples.text: accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan'ti

iti kāmayogavisaṃyogo bhavayogavisaṃyogo diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo avijjāyogavisaṃyogo, visaṃyutto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi saṃkilesikehi ponobhavikehi sadarehi dukkhavipākehi āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇikehi. tasmā yogakkhemī'ti vuccati.

54225.meaning2: who has conquered the bond of rebirth

54228.commentary: (SNa) tesu yogaṃ āpajjatī'ti upayogaṃ sayaṃ tesaṃ kiccānaṃ kattabbataṃ āpajjati.

examples.text: paṭisallāṇe, bhikkhave, yogam'āpajjatha. paṭisallīṇo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

54229.meaning1: comes under the yoke; is under the control; is in the power (of)
54229.commentary: (SNa) yogam'āyanti maccuno'ti maccuno yogaṃ payogaṃ pakkhepaṃ upakkhepaṃ upakkamaṃ abbhantaraṃ āgacchanti, maraṇavasaṃ gacchantī'ti attho.

examples.text: akkheyyasaññino sattā, akkheyyasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, akkheyyaṃ apariññāya, yogam'āyanti maccuno.

examples.text: te yogayuttā mārassa, ayogakkhemino janā, sattā gacchanti saṃsāraṃ, jātimaraṇagāmino.

examples.text: te o e'icc'ete āva āy'ādese pāpuṇanti kārite. lāveti, nāyeti. yogavibhāgena aññasmim'pi ekārassa āy'ādeso hoti. gāyati, gāyanti.

54235.commentary: (SNa) tesu yogaṃ āpajjatī'ti upayogaṃ sayaṃ tesaṃ kiccānaṃ kattabbataṃ āpajjati.

54236.meaning1: who has overcome the bond; who has transcended bondage

54238.commentary: (PMa) yog'āvacaro'ti samathayoge, vipassanāyoge vā avacaratī'ti yog'āvacaro. avacaratī'ti pavisitvā caratī'ti.

examples.text: vatthuvijj'ācariyo viya hi bhagavā. so yathā vatthuvijj'ācariyo nagarabhūmiṃ passitvā suṭṭhu upaparikkhitvā ettha nagaraṃ māpethā'ti upadisati, sotthinā ca nagare niṭṭhite rājakulato mahāsakkāraṃ labhati, evam'eva yog'āvacarassa anurūpaṃ sen'āsanaṃ upaparikkhitvā ettha kammaṭṭhānaṃ anuyuñjitabban'ti upadisati.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
tayo satipaṭṭhānā yad'ariyo sevati yad'ariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam'anusāsitum'arahati, so vuccati yogg'ācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathī'ti

tatra idaṃ nissāya idaṃ pajahatha, tayo satipaṭṭhānā yadariyo sevati yadariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam'anusāsitum'arahati, so vuccati yogg'ācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathī'ti, ayam'uddeso saḷāyatanavibhaṅgassa.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo. tam'enaṃ dakkho yogg'ācariyo assadammasārathi abhiruhitvā, vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā, dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā, yen'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyya'pi paccāsāreyya'pi.

54289.notes: (MW) the thongs by which an animal is attached to the pole of a carriage. the tie of the yoke of a plough.

examples.text: saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.
sabbanaṅgalāni saddhiṃ balibaddarasmiyottehi jāṇussoṇissa ratho viya rajataparikkhittāni honti.
yo hi koci manussesu, issatthaṃ upajīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, yodh'ājīvo na brāhmaṇo.
etth'ev'assa dvattiṃsāya puttehi saddhiṃ sīsaṃ chinditvā āharathā'ti tehi saddhiṃ aññe'pi samatthe mahāyodhe pesesi

54291.meaning1: whoever here; whoever in this regard

examples.text: yo'dha koci manussesu, parapāṇāni hiṃsati, asmā lokā paramhā ca, ubhayā dhaṃsate naro.
yo'dha kāme accatari, saṅgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati n'ājjheti, chinnasoto abandhano.

54292.commentary: (SNa) yodh'ājīvo'ti yuddhena jīvikaṃ kappanako dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi evaṃ gahitanāmo. (ANa) yodh'ājīvā'ti yuddh'ūpajīvino.

examples.text: so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
catūhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato yodh'ājīvo rāj'āraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi catūhi?

54298.meaning1: like a warrior; similar to a soldier

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañc'ime yodhājīv'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu. katame pañca?
